text:
anya: FYI the sampleapp onboarding run hit a weird mismatch between the REST checklist and the Node SDK. SDK doesn't expose a routes:list equivalent so the onboarding healthcheck fails

matt: oh no. which call is the sampleapp expecting?

anya: the flow expects to call GET /v1/routes to verify customer routes+policies before starting the worker. SDK has listRoutes but it only returns route ids (no 'visibility' or 'policy' fields). sampleapp asserts visibility == 'public' and errors out.

alex: hmm we intentionally trimmed route metadata to keep payloads small. SDK returns summaries only, but REST returns full objects. didn't realize sampleapp validated visibility.

sara: this is two-fold: parity (missing fields) and param-name drift. REST uses "visibility" string, SDK used "is_public": boolean. sampleapp checks the string and crashes.

anya: repro steps I ran locally:
```
# failing call via SDK
const r = await client.listRoutes({project: 'demo'});
// r[0] -> { id: 'r_123', is_public: true }
// sampleapp does: if (route.visibility !== 'public') throw
```
vs REST:
```
GET /v1/routes?project=demo
[ { id: 'r_123', visibility: 'public', policy: { ... } } ]
```

matt: oof. Also saw different retry semantics on our onboarding webhook: REST 429 returns Retry-After header and SDK's default retry/backoff didn't honor the header (it used internal exponential backoff). We got duplicated provisioning calls.

infra-bot: @matt triggered alert: provisioning-duplication-rate +12% during SDK onboarding runs (2026-03-22T10:13Z).

alex: the SDK's retry layer predates standardized Retry-After handling. We should add header-aware backoff and a config toggle to prefer server guidance.

anya: proposal: 1) quick patch to SDK to include full route object shape (visibility, policy) behind an opt-in param like includeDetails=true; 2) follow-up to normalize param names (is_public -> visibility) with a compatibility shim for 6 months; 3) update SDK retry to honor Retry-After header and expose backoff config.

sara: also flagging docs/sampleapp: change validation to accept either shape for next 2 weeks so onboarding doesn't break customers while SDK ships.

matt: timelines? can we hotfix includeDetails=true in SDK today and ship docs change?

alex: I can cut a patch branch and publish a beta this afternoon. will add Retry-After support but that needs a minor semver bump and tests.

anya: awesome. I'll open a small sampleapp PR to relax the check and add a unit test for both shapes.

devex-bot: Note: created tickets - SDK-482 (includeDetails param), SDK-483 (retry-after backoff), DOCS-201 (sampleapp validation loosening).

matt: thanks. small ask: add a short note in the changelog explaining the transient parity shim and recommended migration path. a lot of customers rely on exact field names. :eyes:

anya: agreed. I'll draft changelog blurb and send for review. thanks team :thumbsup:
